title: Sthapana
writeup: Ganpati Bappa arrived at Bhagyanagar today! The mandap came alive as our Ganapati idol was installed with full rituals, marking the start of the 49th year of Sarvajanik Shri Ganesh Utsav Mandal's celebrations. The evening aarti brought the whole galli together — chants, dhol, and that first glimpse of Bappa lighting up everyone's faces. 11 days of festivities begin now. Belgaum cha Bhagyavidhata has arrived. 🙏
